svg.title: 0% Business Credit Stack Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-zero-percent-stack-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: 0% Business Credit Stack Roadmap; subtitle: Personal file first, Chase next, sequenced banks, exit written before deployment; caption: The stack is won or lost on the personal file; one 0% round on a fresh entity runs about $100K on average and about $225K at the top end.; assumptions note: Week labels order the practitioner gates into a sequence; no practitioner reported a four-week calendar. Bank count splits from three to four up to eleven.; note: Attributed to Colin Matthew, Jack McColl (BetterWealth), HowToCredit, Cal Barton, Marvin Francois and Gap Funding.; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Audit the personal credit profile; deliverable: 680 minimum, 720-plus preferred, utilization near 10%, two or fewer recent inquiries; gate: Under three hard inquiries on every bureau; week: Week 2; title: Apply at Chase first; deliverable: Ink Unlimited at $30-40K plus Ink Preferred at $40-60K for $70-100K at Chase; gate: Confirm the 0% covers purchases, balance transfers or both; week: Week 3; title: Sequence the remaining banks; deliverable: Chase then US Bank; ask Navy Federal and PNC for multiple cards on one hard pull; gate: Stop at three to four banks or run up to eleven; week: Week 4; title: Deploy with the exit written first; deliverable: Liquidate at 2.5% to about 6% depending on the route; gate: Borrow only what could be repaid within six months if the deal stalls
